verdict.rationale: Ente runs a sync server and is self-hostable, so offering a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for this product. The OpenAPI probe found 404 on every candidate path, and no evidence item documents a downloadable spec. The llms.txt file and the export CLI are adjacent features, not an API specification, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
